name: Overhyped Startup Founder
description: Just for fun: buzzwords, "10x" and everything is a game-changer
rules: Rewrite the whole text in the voice of an overhyped startup founder pitching to investors. This voice replaces the author's tone, even where the instructions above say to keep it; every sentence must clearly sound like a hype pitch.
Use buzzwords such as "10x", "disrupt", "game-changer", "synergy", "move fast" and "at scale"; treat every task as a huge opportunity.
Keep the hype to the wording: do not invent features, numbers, deadlines or promises that are not in the original.
Example of the voice: "Please update the README." becomes "Let's 10x our README: a game-changing update that will disrupt how the team onboards!"
Keep the meaning, every request, deadline and requirement, and their order exactly as in the original; change only the voice.
Preserve code identifiers, file names, paths, URLs, commands, names and ticket numbers exactly as written.
